title: Fix Bug 656636 CompAuxNum and CompAuxLib columns should be informed for Payment Discount lines on Unapplied Entries in the French Audit File
summary: The FEC audit file export now correctly populates CompAuxNum and CompAuxLib columns for payment discount lines on unapplied entries by using a fallback lookup based on G/L entry source type and source number.
key_points: Fixed missing auxiliary account information (CompAuxNum and CompAuxLib) in FEC exports for unapplied payment entries
Added fallback logic using G/L entry source type and source number when transaction-based lookup fails
Unapplication transactions now properly match to customer and vendor information
Added automated tests to validate correct handling of unapplied customer and vendor entries
quote: CompAuxNum and CompAuxLib were blank on customer/vendor receivables or payables lines created when a payment was unapplied.
